directions: From Roscommon test centre, set off along Circular Road and take your first left, staying on Circular Road
You will meet a roundabout very quickly, so take the 1st exit to continue on Circular Road
Keep your observations sharp because a second roundabout follows shortly after, and again you take the 1st exit onto Circular Road
Continue along Circular Road for roughly 300 metres to the next roundabout, taking the 1st exit once more
